odu.diviner_operation_cue: A charter was written before the ink had time to dry, and the signatories are already revising what they signed.
odu.shadow_tendency: the founding document excludes what it cannot name
odu.map_maker_move: inscribe the charter, seal the founding moment
odu.path_finder_move: delay closure until the unnamed constituencies arrive
odu.echo_omen_cue: Every founding carries the fracture it refuses to acknowledge.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Charter Hall has convened its first assembly, but the seats were arranged before the invitation list was complete.
odu.visible_world_effect: A new civic charter binds the Foundries into shared purpose, but its terms were set before every district could speak.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: Charter Hall stands declared; the next turn inherits a constitution that is either shelter or cage.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination open the charter to revision, or will it harden into law before the missing voices arrive?

odu.diviner_operation_cue: What was allowed to decay has begun feeding something no one planted.
odu.closure_tendency: let go before the loss is understood
odu.shadow_tendency: renewal erases the debt owed to what was destroyed
odu.map_maker_move: catalogue what was lost, audit the dissolution
odu.path_finder_move: follow the nutrients downward into new soil
odu.echo_omen_cue: Past dreamers composted a district once; what grew back was not what anyone expected.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Fade District has surrendered its old infrastructure to managed decay, and the first volunteer ecologies are already pushing through the cracks.
odu.hidden_cost: grief and displacement from those who called the old structures home
odu.visible_world_effect: Managed entropy transforms an abandoned district into experimental ground, but its former inhabitants have no seat in what emerges.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: Fade District composts in public view; the next turn decides who gets to cultivate what grows.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination honor the displaced, or will it treat the ruins as blank canvas?

odu.diviner_operation_cue: Lens Tower has made everything visible, and now nothing can hide — including the contradictions the leadership preferred to keep in shadow.
odu.closure_tendency: reveal everything, trusting that truth alone heals
odu.shadow_tendency: total visibility destroys the privacy that trust requires
odu.map_maker_move: publish the data, let the record speak
odu.path_finder_move: protect the spaces where learning still needs shade
odu.echo_omen_cue: A previous transparency drive exposed corruption but also destroyed the informal networks that held a district together.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Lens Tower has published the full civic ledger, and the Bridge Districts can now see every transaction, contract, and quiet arrangement.
odu.visible_world_effect: Full transparency arrives in the Bridge Districts, empowering citizens but stripping away the negotiation space that made compromise possible.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: Lens Tower has opened every ledger; the next turn decides whether clarity becomes wisdom or prosecution.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination create institutions worthy of what has been revealed, or will exposure become punishment?

odu.diviner_operation_cue: The gate was shut to protect what was inside, but the lock also trapped the thing that needed to leave.
odu.closure_tendency: seal the boundary to preserve what exists
odu.shadow_tendency: protection becomes imprisonment for what must circulate
odu.map_maker_move: fortify the boundary, define inside and outside
odu.path_finder_move: find the passage that lets circulation resume without collapse
odu.echo_omen_cue: The Root Wards sealed their gates once before; what they preserved became stale, and what they excluded became feral.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Gate Quarter has locked its thresholds against perceived threat, and the Root Wards now breathe only their own air.
odu.visible_world_effect: The Root Wards achieve safety by sealing their borders, but the districts beyond the gate begin adapting without them.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: Gate Quarter is sealed; the next turn determines whether the walls open from within or are breached from without.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination create a passage that honors both protection and exchange?

odu.diviner_operation_cue: A latent path has been restored to the active field.
odu.closure_tendency: restore latent path and excluded memory
odu.path_finder_move: recover latent memory-path, restore buried route
odu.echo_omen_cue: What returns from concealment rarely returns alone; it brings its old tensions with it.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: The Root Archive has reopened old songs, routes, and civic rites, but the grievance buried with them has also returned to public hearing.
odu.visible_gain: memory, repair, or plurality re-enters the weave
odu.visible_world_effect: Archival memory and old rites return to public life, reopening both continuity and grievance.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: The Root Archive has remembered forward by restoring what the city once sealed away.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination make room for the returned memory, or will it retreat the moment old grievances begin speaking with new authority?

odu.diviner_operation_cue: The inheritance arrived scrambled, and the heirs cannot agree on the original pattern.
odu.closure_tendency: accept the scramble as creative opportunity
odu.shadow_tendency: disorder destroys the thread of legitimate succession
odu.map_maker_move: reconstruct the original pattern from fragments
odu.path_finder_move: weave a new pattern from the scrambled threads
odu.echo_omen_cue: The Loom Exchange has been scrambled before; those who rewove fastest inherited the most, and equity was the first casualty.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Loom Exchange has redistributed its contracts in a disordered burst, and the Commons of Ethos now holds thread without knowing its provenance.
odu.hidden_cost: loss of provenance and accountable succession
odu.visible_world_effect: Economic contracts scatter and reform unpredictably, freeing some from old debts but severing others from earned claims.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: The Loom Exchange has scattered its threads; the next turn decides who gets to reweave them.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination establish a new weaving order, or will the scramble become permanent chaos?

odu.diviner_operation_cue: The feast was so generous that the hosts forgot to keep seed for next season.
odu.closure_tendency: give everything now, trust that abundance will return
odu.shadow_tendency: generosity conceals the depletion it accelerates
odu.map_maker_move: audit the reserves, pace the distribution
odu.path_finder_move: celebrate the giving but plant the next harvest before the table empties
odu.echo_omen_cue: Feast Market has overflowed before; the morning after abundance is always quieter than the night before.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Feast Market has distributed its reserves in a surge of communal generosity, and the Commons of Ethos glows with shared warmth even as the granaries thin.
odu.hidden_cost: depletion of reserves needed for the next season
odu.visible_world_effect: A wave of communal generosity transforms the Commons, but the infrastructure that sustains it is quietly running down.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: Feast Market has given everything; the next turn inherits warmth and an empty cupboard.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination replenish what was given, or will generosity become the prelude to scarcity?

odu.diviner_operation_cue: The frame was drawn too quickly, and the field complied before it understood the cost.
odu.closure_tendency: accelerate closure before the field is ready
odu.shadow_tendency: brilliance leaves vital relation outside the frame
odu.echo_omen_cue: Every accelerated triumph casts a delayed shadow.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Signal Spire has launched a brilliant public prototype, but the workers and districts left outside its permissions are already forcing themselves back into view.
odu.visible_world_effect: A dazzling civic prototype succeeds at once, but one constituency or relation remains outside the frame of benefit.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: Signal Spire advances under strain; the next turn inherits both the breakthrough and the citizens it failed to carry with it.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination widen the prototype into a commons, or harden it into a citadel with bright walls and missing doors?

odu.diviner_operation_cue: The blade was necessary, but the hand that held it decided what to cut without consulting the body.
odu.closure_tendency: cut decisively to remove the obstruction
odu.shadow_tendency: the surgeon decides what is disease and what is organ
odu.map_maker_move: identify the obstruction, authorize the cut
odu.path_finder_move: ensure the cut serves the body, not the surgeon's preference
odu.echo_omen_cue: Forge Terrace has cut before; some cuts healed clean, others severed things that could not be reattached.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Forge Terrace has enacted a decisive intervention, clearing an obstruction that paralyzed the Foundries, but the severed connection was also someone's lifeline.
odu.hidden_cost: irreversible severance of a living connection
odu.visible_world_effect: A decisive judicial action clears a long-standing obstruction, but the cut also severs a relationship that cannot be restored.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: Forge Terrace has made the cut; the next turn must live with what was separated.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination heal the wound or discover that what was cut away was load-bearing?

odu.predicament_family: The Mirror That Judges the Frame
odu.diviner_operation_cue: The frame has been made to witness its own shadow.
odu.closure_tendency: reflect the frame back upon itself
odu.shadow_tendency: revelation destabilizes authority before a new form can hold
odu.echo_omen_cue: Every revelation asks whether truth heals or merely undoes confidence.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Mirror Court has forced the governing frame to see its own contradiction in public, and now legitimacy trembles while everyone waits to see what form replaces certainty.
odu.hidden_cost: loss of confidence in established order
odu.visible_world_effect: The governing frame recognizes its contradiction in public view, and legitimacy begins to waver before a new form arrives.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: Mirror Court has judged itself before witnesses; the next turn must decide whether revelation becomes reform, rupture, or a furious attempt at denial.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination turn this public contradiction into charter, schism, or suppression?

odu.diviner_operation_cue: The old oath was kept so long that its meaning drifted, and now those who honor it do opposite things.
odu.closure_tendency: hold to the letter of the original agreement
odu.shadow_tendency: fidelity to the oath becomes betrayal of its spirit
odu.path_finder_move: renegotiate the covenant in the light of what was learned
odu.echo_omen_cue: Bond Archive holds oaths that outlived the conditions they were sworn to meet; loyalty without revision becomes a trap.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Bond Archive has enforced an ancient compact, and the Archive Coast now discovers that fidelity to the oath's letter contradicts its original intent.
odu.hidden_cost: the oath now binds parties to outcomes neither intended
odu.visible_world_effect: An honored covenant produces consequences its authors never imagined, and the parties bound by it are now trapped between loyalty and reason.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: Bond Archive has spoken the old words; the next turn decides whether the oath is renewed, rewritten, or broken.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination find language to renew the compact, or will the old words become a prison?

odu.diviner_operation_cue: The remedy was applied to the symptom while the source continued seeping into the shared water.
odu.closure_tendency: treat the visible symptom and declare health restored
odu.shadow_tendency: the source of contagion adapts faster than the remedy
odu.map_maker_move: quarantine the visible outbreak, restore confidence
odu.path_finder_move: trace the contamination upstream to its source
odu.echo_omen_cue: Reservoir Commons has been treated before; the well ran clear for a season, then the old seepage returned with resistance.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Reservoir Commons has declared its water safe after targeted treatment, but the deeper aquifer still carries what the surface remedy cannot reach.
odu.visible_gain: immediate relief and restored public confidence
odu.hidden_cost: the root contamination adapts and returns stronger
odu.visible_world_effect: Visible health improves while the systemic source of harm remains untouched, building toward a harder crisis.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: Reservoir Commons flows clean today; the next turn discovers whether the remedy reached deep enough.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination pursue the source, or will it trust the surface and move on?

odu.diviner_operation_cue: The artist wagered everything on the audience's capacity to bear what was revealed, and now the room must decide if it can hold the truth.
odu.closure_tendency: reveal the hidden and trust the commons to metabolize it
odu.shadow_tendency: not every truth survives exposure to public light
odu.map_maker_move: curate the revelation, control the frame
odu.path_finder_move: let the revelation stand raw and trust the audience
odu.echo_omen_cue: Glass Agora has staged radical truths before; some transformed the district, others emptied it.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Glass Agora has mounted a public work that exposes the Bridge Districts' concealed history, and the audience is still deciding whether to weep or to leave.
odu.hidden_cost: some truths shatter the audience that receives them
odu.visible_world_effect: A public artistic revelation forces the Bridge Districts to confront what they concealed, and the response is not yet settled.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: Glass Agora has shown what was hidden; the next turn lives with what the audience decides to do with what it saw.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination build a container for the revealed truth, or will the exposure become its own wound?

odu.diviner_operation_cue: The foundation was deferred again, and those who wait are beginning to wonder whether patience has become abandonment.
odu.closure_tendency: delay the foundation until conditions are perfect
odu.shadow_tendency: infinite patience becomes indistinguishable from refusal
odu.map_maker_move: set the timeline, define the conditions for action
odu.path_finder_move: plant something small now rather than wait for the perfect season
odu.echo_omen_cue: Seed Vault has held its reserves through many seasons; some seeds lost their viability while waiting for the right moment.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Seed Vault has again deferred its planting season, and the Dreaming Quarter now holds potential that has never been tested by soil.
odu.visible_gain: preservation of options and unrealized potential
odu.hidden_cost: seeds that are never planted never prove their worth
odu.visible_world_effect: The reserves remain intact but untested, and the community begins to divide between those who counsel patience and those who demand planting.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: Seed Vault holds its treasure still; the next turn decides whether patience is wisdom or paralysis.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination break ground, or will the seeds wait another season in the dark?

odu.predicament_family: The Festival on the Fault Line
odu.diviner_operation_cue: The festival was so joyful that no one noticed the fault line running through the dance floor.
odu.closure_tendency: celebrate to heal, even when the wound is still open
odu.shadow_tendency: joy can be used to silence the grief that has not been processed
odu.map_maker_move: schedule the festival, manage the optics
odu.path_finder_move: let the festival include a space for mourning
odu.echo_omen_cue: Rhythm Court has danced on fault lines before; the music always stops eventually.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Rhythm Court has declared a festival of renewal, and the Commons of Ethos gathers in celebration even as the ground beneath them holds unresolved fractures.
odu.visible_world_effect: A civic festival brings the Commons together in visible harmony, but the fracture it was meant to heal is merely papered over by music.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: Rhythm Court dances; the next turn discovers whether the celebration healed the ground or merely hid the crack.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination honor the grief beneath the joy, or will the festival become the only permitted memory?

odu.diviner_operation_cue: The origin was revisited, and what was found there did not match the story that had been told.
odu.closure_tendency: return to the origin to restore lost coherence
odu.shadow_tendency: the origin is always partly invented by those who need it
odu.map_maker_move: codify the origin myth, stabilize the narrative
odu.path_finder_move: let the origin be strange enough to teach something new
odu.echo_omen_cue: Origin Gate has been reopened before; each time, what was found inside revised the story the city told itself.
odu.seeker_manifestation_cue: Origin Gate has been unsealed, and the Dreaming Quarter now faces a founding story that does not match the one in the charter.
odu.visible_gain: access to original intent and forgotten purpose
odu.hidden_cost: the founding myth may not survive its own archaeology
odu.visible_world_effect: The city's origin story is contested by what the reopened gate reveals, and the institutions built on that story now stand on shifting ground.
odu.narrator_handoff_cue: Origin Gate is open; the next turn decides whether the city rewrites its story or closes the gate again.
odu.next_question: Will the next divination build on the revised origin, or will it seal the gate and preserve the comfortable myth?
